visual_elements.description: Self-attention dataflow for one query word (X₂): (1) KEYS stack of 4 embedding chips X₁-X₄ (vertical, dashed green border); red connector lines run right into a tan 'Dot Product' box containing 4 blue dot nodes; the highlighted X₂ chip fans out with red arrows to all 4 dots (dot products of query with every key), and each dot sends a red arrow rightward. (2) Arrows enter a vertical pale-pink 'Soft max' bar. (3) Four red arrows exit Soft max left-to-right, labeled W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ (blue), each terminating in a red ⊗ (multiply) node. (4) Red lines from the Values stack (4 chips X₁-X₄, vertical, dashed green border, X₂ highlighted) enter each ⊗ node from the right. (5) Each ⊗ sends a red arrow upward into a light-blue Σ box. (6) A thick green block arrow points up-left from Σ to an output chip labeled X₂ (green-highlighted label) enclosed in a dashed green rectangle — the attention output for word 2. (7) A dashed red curved arrow runs from the bottom Query row / Q label up to the bottom of the KEYS stack, showing the query being compared with ALL keys. Magenta callouts annotate stage 1-2 ('Matched KEYS with Relevance Percentage') and stage 5-6 ('Retrieve VALUES Weighted by their Relevance').

Embedding-vector chips: each chip is a small white rectangle split into cells — leftmost cell holds the label X₁/X₂/X₃/X₄ (colored subscript), remaining cells colored green, yellow, lavender. Chips appear in 4 groups: KEYS stack (vertical, 4 chips), Values stack (vertical, 4 chips), Query row (horizontal, 4 chips, bottom), and single output chip (top). In every group the X₂ chip is emphasized with a large translucent yellow circle; the Query row's X₂ additionally has a short red arrow pointing at it from lower-left.

Second word of each ('Key'/'Value'/'Query') is red, rest black.
Two light-blue rounded callout boxes with magenta italic bold text: 'Matched KEYS with Relevance Percentage' (upper center-left) and 'Retrieve VALUES Weighted by their Relevance' (upper right).
Question box: white rectangle with blue bold two-line text 'Should we use SAME X₂ Vector / for the three Roles ?' where 'X₂' is red.

visual_elements.description: Arrow inventory (exact counts): 4 red connector lines from the 4 KEYS chips into the Dot Product box; 4 red fan-out arrows from the highlighted X₂ key chip to the 4 blue dots inside the box; 4 red arrows from the 4 dots to the Soft max bar; 4 red arrows from Soft max to the 4 ⊗ nodes (labeled W₂₁-W₂₄); 4 red lines from the Values stack into the ⊗ nodes from the right (one per node); 4 red arrows from the 4 ⊗ nodes up into the Σ box — 24 solid red straight arrows/lines in total; 1 thick green block arrow (Σ to output chip); 1 dashed red curved arrow (Query row up to the KEYS stack); 1 small solid red arrow pointing at the query X₂ chip; 3 thin red leader lines from the role-annotation boxes.

recreation_brief: 1. Slide size 16:9, white background #FFFFFF; use bold sans-serif ~12-14pt for all diagram labels unless a step specifies otherwise. 2. Title block, centered at top (~4-13% height): line 1 'Self Attention Mechanism (Input Word plays Different Roles)', Arial bold ~28pt black #000000, with a yellow #FFFF00 text-highlight on the parenthetical '(Input Word plays Different Roles)'. 3. Title line 2 (subtitle), centered directly below line 1: '(Query using X₂ All Keys in Dictionary and retrieve Corresponding Values' — bold ~18-20pt, verbatim with NO closing parenthesis; color 'Query', 'Keys', 'Values' red #C00000 and 'X₂' blue #0070C0, remaining words black. 4. Slide-number badge, top-right (~91-97% width, ~7-14% height): circle filled #FFD966 with olive #808000 outline, black bold '30' centered. 5. Diagram canvas: rounded rectangle spanning ~4-96% width and ~21-99% height, fill #FBE5D6, thin #C00000 border. 6. Vector-chip template: small white rectangle split into cells — leftmost cell holds the label X₁/X₂/X₃/X₄ (colored subscript), remaining cells green #A9D18E, yellow #FFD966, lavender #C9A7E8. Place 4 groups: (a) KEYS stack, 4 chips X₁-X₄ vertical at ~6-15% width, ~40-71% height; (b) Values stack, 4 chips X₁-X₄ vertical at ~80-89% width, ~40-71% height; (c) Query row, 4 chips X₁-X₄ horizontal at ~18-52% width within the ~76-96% height band; (d) output chip, single X₂ chip at ~56-65% width in the ~22-38% height band. 7. Emphasis: wrap the KEYS stack, Values stack and Query row each in a dashed #00B050 rounded rectangle; enclose the output chip in a dashed #00B050 rectangle; overlay a ~50%-transparent #FFFF00 circle on the X₂ chip in each of the 4 groups; render the output chip's X₂ label in green. 8. Tan pills (#E8CFA0 fill, dark-red text): 'KEYS' above the left stack, 'Values' above the right stack, and a two-line pill 'Query' / 'ALL Keys with X₂' at the left end of the bottom Query area (~12-18% width); add bold red #C00000 letters 'K' right of the KEYS stack, 'V' left of the Values stack, and 'Q' in a circle right of the Query pill. 9. Dot Product box: tan #D9BF9B vertical rectangle at ~26-36% width, ~34-73% height, 'Dot Product' label at its top; place 4 dark-blue dots vertically inside; draw 4 red #C00000 connector lines from the 4 KEYS chips into the box, 4 red fan-out arrows from the highlighted X₂ key chip to the 4 dots, and 4 red arrows from the dots to the box's right edge toward Soft max. 10. Soft max bar: pale-pink #F5C9D4 vertical rounded bar at ~48-52% width, ~35-73% height, with 'Soft max' rotated 90° in magenta. 11. Weighted-sum column: 4 red arrows from the Soft max bar to 4 red ⊗ circle nodes at ~56-60% width, evenly spaced across ~40-70% height; label the arrows W₂₁, W₂₂, W₂₃, W₂₄ in blue #0070C0; draw 4 red lines from the Values stack into the ⊗ nodes from the right (one per node); draw 4 red arrows from the ⊗ nodes upward into the Σ box — a light-blue #CCE4F7 rectangle at ~54-68% width, ~22-38% height containing a large dark-navy 'Σ'. 12. Output arrow: thick green #00B050 block arrow from the Σ box pointing up-left to the output chip. 13. Callout 1: light-blue #D6EAF8 rounded box at ~33-50% width, ~26-32% height, magenta #CC00CC bold italic text 'Matched KEYS with Relevance Percentage'. 14. Callout 2: light-blue #D6EAF8 rounded box at ~66-88% width, ~26-32% height, magenta #CC00CC bold italic text 'Retrieve VALUES Weighted by their Relevance'. 15. Role annotations, 3 white boxes with thin red #C00000 borders, two-line centered text and red leader lines: 'X₂ is used as Key' ('Key' in red) at center-left between the KEYS stack and the Dot Product box, leader line to the highlighted key X₂; 'X₂ is used as Value' ('Value' in red) at center-right between the ⊗ column and the Values stack, leader line to the highlighted value X₂; 'X₂ is used as Query' ('Query' in red) at bottom-center above the Query row, leader line pointing down to the highlighted query X₂. 16. Query-flow arrows: 1 dashed red #C00000 curved arrow from the Q / Query-row area rising to the bottom of the KEYS stack, and 1 small solid red arrow pointing at the Query row's X₂ chip from lower-left. 17. Question box: white rectangle at ~60-87% width, ~81-92% height, bold blue #0070C0 two-line text 'Should we use SAME X₂ Vector / for the three Roles ?' with 'X₂' in red #C00000, preserving the space before '?'.
